alignments.note: 'How long' renders עַד־מָתַי jointly; neither English word writes either morpheme's own lexeme ('until'/'when'), so the pair is indivisible (rule 6), anchored on the first source token. No matrix frame is written, so rule 17's duration-frame ruling does not apply; a split giving 'long' to עַד and 'How' to מָתַי was considered and rejected as arbitrary.
Auxiliary and subject pronoun with the verb (rule 17).
Adverbial accusative 'injustice' rendered as the adverb 'unjustly'.
נָשָׂא of the 'lift the face' idiom rendered 'respect'; the ASV spends a separate word on the noun, so rule 2 splits rather than fusing.
Anarthrous substantival adjective as rectum: 'of' under rule 19, supplied 'the' under rule 46.

review_notes: עַד־מָתַי treated as one noncompositional 'How long' unit; competing split noted in the unit.
